description:
Cast Theoretical Duplication by paying {2}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing all opponent to copy Theoretical Duplication.
Resolve each Theoretical Duplication, causing all players to create a token of all creatures that enter the battlefield under an opponent's control this turn.
Cast Phage by paying {3}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Each opponent's Theoretical Duplication triggers.
Resolve the first Theoretical Duplication trigger, causing the opponent to create a token copy of Phage.
The Phage token enters the battlefield, causing its controller to lose the game.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
